items.title: Spin plans flop as Taskin seeks the ‘extraordinary’ on Day 2 of Sylhet Test
items.summary: Skipper Najmul Hossain Shanto banked on the same trio of spinners from the preceding Mirpur Test, which they lost by eight wickets, and they turned up with a sterile performance. What could have prompted such a decision when spinners not only struggled lately, but the Sylhet surface too provides something for the quicks?
